title: Keep Library dropdowns open during auto refresh
summary: Preserve focused Library Profile dropdown controls across automatic WebView refreshes.
reason: The shared 4-second automatic refresh rebuilt the Library Profiles DOM even when the operator had a Library dropdown focused, which closed the native dropdown while it was being used.
behavior_before: Automatic refresh called the Library Profiles renderer without refresh-mode context, so unchanged focused Library controls could be replaced and native dropdown popups closed.
behavior_after: Automatic refresh passes refresh-mode context and the Library Profiles renderer defers only automatic DOM rebuilds while a Library control is focused; manual refresh and post-blur automatic refresh still repaint normally.
